rv.q: It's a warm embrace, a welcome back to the communal world of theater, and a reminder of our past lives before they were upended.
This performance opens the audience up, and gracefully acknowledges forgiveness and love as the only stop to a cycle of resentment and anger.
A flawless production?? – not by this writer’s lights. Yet--- it’s accessible and LIVE !
Each one of the excellent cast members makes Shakespearean English roll off the tongue as if it were being spoken on a daily basis.

cn.t: Shakespeare's "The Tempest" marks a triumphant return to live theater post-COVID, with critics praising the timely outdoor production that resonates with newfound relevance after a year of collective loss and isolation.
